changes: Resident split evaluation keeps the allocation/error readback, then encodes task/gather, scoring, finalization and winner extraction in one command. Five completions become two; encoders are reused across nodes. Public calls remain synchronous.

Separate integer and precise parent staging prevents queued-input overwrite. Resident vector parents bind their owned buffer directly. Completed operation counts are preserved; shared command duration is recorded once.

Dense compressed histogram pages with at least 1024 features and 4096 selected rows can use the existing shared/tiled kernels, retaining the old 16384-row rule and all density/capacity guards. No histogram shader arithmetic changes.

Conservative split screening uses widened native FP32 intervals from integer sums. Hessian lower bounds must prove child validity; unsupported or uncertain cases receive unbounded intervals. Survivor scoring stays binary64.
reviews: Three subagents owned the host, histogram and bound changes. Host/histogram agents independently reviewed queued ownership; host and root reviewed conservative bound validity. No new public API or runtime tuning flag.

feature_tasks.new_case: Read-only mapped integer/precise parents force separate staging while GPU work remains queued; repeated/growing workspaces.

correctness.before_after: All 18 MPS models, margin arrays and per-round metric histories match the historical references exactly; all 9 CPU controls reproduce their CPU references. Every MPS worker also checks exact same-model CPU prediction.
correctness.scope: Focused acceptance, not a full-suite rerun. Independent CPU/MPS training still differs. No NVIDIA execution.

cpu_sampling.source: 9919a31 baseline, 25Kx4096, 40 rounds; separate diagnostic excluded from timing comparisons.
cpu_sampling.interpretation: Waiting includes necessary GPU execution and scheduling; 96% wait samples do not imply 96% avoidable overhead.
cpu_sampling.initial_attempt: PATH sample resolved to a broken Python entrypoint; initial diagnostic terminated without a valid result. Retried using the macOS utility; failed attempt retained and excluded.

histogram_path_diagnostic.recommendation: Retain old >=16384 rows eligibility; additionally allow compressed dense pages with >=1024 features and >=4096 selected rows, retaining all capacity guards and geometry. No kernel arithmetic changes.

native_bound_diagnostic.note: Frozen prototype passed 1033495 containment checks and 1992 scalar cases. Production adds boundary cases; final counts above. Baseline screening is enabled for a fair 9919a31 comparison. Retains the 7% missing-data regression in one microbenchmark shape.

dataset.name: higgs
dataset.preprocessing: Original row order; header=None; labels unchanged; no scaling

training.note: Fresh workers; 100 rounds, depth 6, max_bin 256, eight threads. CPU and isolated baseline/candidate MPS variants run sequentially. Wide datasets have 64 informative features without column sampling. HIGGS has 10.5M training and 500K test rows.

split_counter_note: Baseline sums four separate command intervals after allocation readback; candidate records one contiguous span for task/gather, scoring, finalization and winner extraction, including inter-encoder/scheduling gaps. First allocation readback and standalone calls are separately timed. Ratios are not isolated scoring-kernel speedups; the difference may include actual scheduling changes as well as changed measurement boundaries.

installed_package.isolation: python -I; cwd outside checkout; no PYTHONPATH or DYLD_LIBRARY_PATH; pytest pythonpath override empty

limits: Warm runtime, fresh worker/matrices, 100 rounds, depth 6, max_bin 256, eight CPU threads. Training includes quantization/evaluation; generation/loading, matrix setup and final prediction are separate.
Wide cases use 64 informative columns without column sampling: 100000x1024 and 25000x4096. HIGGS uses 10.5M training/500K test rows and 28 features, but 100 rather than the published 1000 rounds.
This task ran no concurrent builds/tests/benchmarks during timing. Unrelated sessions and applications were not controlled. AC power throughout, clock checks pass, system-wide swap substantial.
GPU family counters can overlap; do not sum them or subtract them from wall time to infer host work.

Three repeats on one M3. All six wide before/after pairs improve; one HIGGS pair regresses slightly. CPU wins two of three 4096-column pairs despite its higher median, so the ratio of medians alone is misleading for that CPU comparison.
